title: Dan Barry
description: "Since STAR WARS is part of the 'space fantasy' adventure genre," observes Dan Barry, "l decided, as a kind of 'in' joke, to put Han Solo in a Flash Gordon-like situation and setting." Decades ago, Barry brought his own unique brand of gritty neo-realism to comics, and his early FLASH GORDON and TARZAN newspaper strips attest to this. Other early work includes AIRBOY, THE HEAP (both of which he co-created), VALKYRIE, SKY WOLF and DAREDEVIL; more recent work includes TOYBOY, MS. MYSTIC, PREDATOR, CRAZYMAN, ZELDA, INDIANA JONES and YOUNG INDIANA JONES. Barry is currently working with Mike Baron on a NEXUS project, and is planning a sequel to his acclaimed BLOODY SANDS OF TIME.
